name: python-kd-tree
title: KD-Tree
blurb: A 2-d kd-tree over integer point pairs: membership answers equal a set's, a rectangle answer equals the brute-force filter, the nearest answer equals the brute-force argmin with the tie on the lexicographically smallest point, and a rebuild from the in-order walk answers identically.
default_description: A 2-d kd-tree over integer point pairs whose nearest answer equals the brute-force argmin on any seeded corpus.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a split divides, never the answer
